Summaries.eng: Hoshitani Yuta enters Ayanagi Academy, a school focusing on show business activities, specifically music. The academy has a group of the grade three students with the highest grades in the musical department, and they are known as the Kao Kai (Cherry Blossom Flower Association). This organization stands at the top of the pecking order within the academy. The shortcut to entering the musical department is to enter the Star Frame class, which is directly taught by the members, and to be recognized by them. Unfortunately, due to their own problems, students Nayuki Toru, Tsukigami Kaito, Tengenji Kakeru, Kuga Shu and Hoshitani Yuta are all struggling to even remain candidates for the musical department. By a stroke of luck, however, the five are spotted by Kao Kai member Otori, and they pique his interest.
Summaries.jpn: 音楽芸能分野の名門校・綾薙学園（あやなぎがくえん）に入学した星谷悠太は中学の時、雨降る無人の野外ステージでただひとりミュージカルを演じたこの学校の生徒に憧れていた。彼が目指すのは入学後に別選考で進む花形コースで、憧れのミュージカルスターも所属していた「ミュージカル学科」。しかしここに入る為には学園のミュージカル学科3年生のうち成績優秀者が所属する「華桜会（かおうかい）」の指導を受けられる「スター枠」に入るのが近道であった。悠太は候補生オーディションで華桜会の異端児・鳳樹に見出され、同じように彼にスター枠として選ばれたメンバー4人とともに「team鳳（チームおおとり）」としてミュージカル学科を目指す。素人同然の悠太以外のメンバーは演劇の才はあるがそれぞれが抱えた問題で候補生に残ることすら覚束ない状況で、加えて華桜会のリーダー・柊翼が彼らとは別に5人のスター枠を選び「team柊（チームひいらぎ）」として立ちはだかる。

綾薙祭を終え、新しい年を迎えた綾薙学園。
ミュージカル学科への入科が決まった星谷たち“元・team鳳”だったが、
指導者である鳳樹は、未だ華桜会を退いたままであった。

星谷たちは『ある想い』を胸に、
鳳を華桜会に復帰させるための作戦を実行に移す。
一方、華桜会メンバーは、そんな後輩たちのひたむきな姿を見守るうち、
自分たちに『忘れ物』があることを思い出し――。

『スタミュ 第2期』全12幕のご視聴ありがとうございました!
次週は特別編♪ 今期ミュージカルパートをまとめてノンストップ放送予定☆

Titles.jpn: スタミュ in ハロウィン

Summaries.eng: A story about Hoshitani and friends on Halloween.
Summaries.jpn:
ミュージカル学科生にひと時の平穏が訪れる秋の終わり――１０月３１日。
星谷たちの住む第１寮に、卒業記念公演でお世話になったＯＢ・早乙女と双葉がやって来た。ちょっと不思議なお土産を持って。
それは大量の西洋カボチャ。そう、今日はハロウィン！　星谷たちは寮でハロウィンパーティーを開くことに。
ジャック・オ・ランタン作り、料理、部屋の飾りつけ、それぞれが分担してパーティーの準備を進めるが、日が暮れて夜の闇が近づくにつれ、事態は思わぬ方向に……？

Summaries.eng:
Yuta Hoshitani entered the prestigious music school, Ayanagi Gakuen, after a fierce special training, following the back of the "longing high school student" he met when he was in junior high school.
He finds out that the person he admires was a student of the school's flower-shaped "Musical Department", and challenges the super-difficult entrance audition.
In the straight line toward the dream, the eyes of the strict examination of the members of the "Hanasakurakai" who reign at the top of the school shine!
Summaries.jpn:
中学の時に出会った『憧れの高校生』の背中を追って、猛特訓の末に音楽の名門・綾薙学園に入学した星谷悠太。
憧れのその人が、学園の花形・『ミュージカル学科』の生徒であったことを知り、超難関の入科オーディションに挑むのだが――。
夢に向かって一直線の星谷に、学園のトップに君臨する、『華桜会』メンバーの厳しい審査の目が光る！

Summaries.eng:
Hoshitani was able to remain a candidate for the musical department as a member of "team Otori" led by Otori, a heretic of the Hanasakurakai.
However, although teammates Nayuki, Tengeji, Tsukiou, and Kukan are perfect, they all have some problems ...
In the jerky air, an unusual practice by Otori begins.
"Come on, Boys. It's time to play!"
Summaries.jpn:
華桜会の異端児・鳳が率いる『team鳳』のメンバーとして、ミュージカル学科の候補生に残ることができた星谷。
しかし、チームメイトの那雪・天花寺・月皇・空閑は、実力は申し分ないものの、みんな何かしらの問題を抱えていて……。
ぎくしゃくとした空気のなか、鳳による、一風変わった稽古が開始される。
「さあ、ボーイズ。遊びの時間だ！」

Summaries.eng:
After the first lesson, Hoshitani realized the difference in ability with his teammates, and every day he worked hard with the support of Nayuki.
However, he couldn't keep up with the pace of training ...
At last, the angry voice of Tengeji, the nobleman of the pear garden, flies to such Hoshitani!
"Leave the team to survive"
So pressed, Hoshiya-? And what is the mysterious secret of the angry Tengeji Temple? !!
Summaries.jpn:
初稽古を経て、チームメイトとの実力の差を思い知った星谷は、那雪のサポートを受けながら自主練に励む日々。
しかし、なかなか稽古のペースについていけず……。
そんな星谷に、ついに梨園の貴公子・天花寺の怒声が飛ぶ！
「チームが生き残るために、チームから外れろ」
そう迫られ、星谷は――？　そして、怒れる天花寺の妖しい秘密とは――？！

Summaries.eng:
The members of Team Otori have begun to be moved by Hoshitani, who continues to make efforts in a straightforward manner.
However, only the Moon Emperor still did not try to get along with them.
The pressure called "Thoroughbred in the musical world" and the complex to the great brother
The moon emperor suffering alone. Knowing such anguish, Hoshitani ...
And finally, the Star of Star frame, team Hiiragi, is here!
Summaries.jpn:
直向きに努力を続ける星谷に、心を動かされ始めたteam鳳のメンバーたち。
しかし、いまだ月皇だけは、彼らと打ち解けようとはしなかった。
『ミュージカル界のサラブレッド』と呼ばれるプレッシャーと、偉大な兄へのコンプレックスに、
ひとり苦しむ月皇。そんな苦悩を知って、星谷は――。
そしてついに、スター・オブ・スター枠、team柊登場！

Summaries.eng:
A test stage "Rookie unveiling performance" to survive as a musical department candidate
Team Otori has finally begun to come together.
However, Hoshitani's lack of power was still a big challenge for the team.

At that time, Hoshitani and his friends witness the performance of Team Hiiragi, the Star of Star frame.
Overwhelmed by its perfection, Hoshitani suddenly feels uneasy.
Summaries.jpn:
ミュージカル学科候補としての生き残りを懸けたテストステージ・『新人お披露目公演』を
目前にして、ようやくまとまり始めたteam鳳。
しかし、いまだ星谷の力不足は、チームにとっての大きな課題だった。

そんな時、スター・オブ・スター枠、team柊のパフォーマンスを目の当たりにする星谷たち。
その完璧さに圧倒された星谷は、突如、不安に駆られ――。

Summaries.eng:
Finally, "Rookie unveiling performance".
It is a tough test stage where half of the teams will drop out of the musical department candidates depending on the screening results.

However, there are still uncertainties in Hoshitani's performance ...
Even in the Shimouma criticism, team Otori, which is a gathering team, is "certainly dropped out" ....

In order to support such students, Otori was planning a secret plan.
As expected, the fate of team Otori is--!

Hoshitani and his colleagues have successfully completed the first semester as candidates for the musical department.
However, the next test stage is coming up in the second semester.
--so,
At the suggestion of Otori, team Otori decided to hold an overnight training camp during the summer vacation.

What was waiting for them in the villa area in the mountains that I visited-abandoned house? !! Bear? !! Or surprising people? !!
Summaries.jpn:
無事に、ミュージカル学科候補生として１学期を終えた星谷たち。
しかし、2学期には次のテストステージが控えている。
――というわけで、
鳳の提案で、夏休みに泊りがけの合宿を行うことになったteam鳳。

訪れた山奥の別荘地で、彼らを待ち受けていたものは――廃屋？！　熊？！　それとも意外なあの人たち？！

Summaries.eng:
The second semester begins, and the outline of the next test stage, "Ayanagi Festival Performance," will be announced.
Hoshitani and his colleagues were told that each team was free to perform at the Ayanagi Festival.
I think of a performance that only we can do, which is unique to us.

On the other hand, the runaway of team Otori at the newcomer's unveiling performance reveals disgust.
One member of the Hanasakurakai-begins to move quietly.
Summaries.jpn:
2学期が始まり、さっそく次のテストステージ、『綾薙祭公演』の概要が発表される。
星谷たちは、綾薙祭での演目は各チームの自由だと聞かされ、
自分たちにしか出来ない、自分たちらしい演目を、と考えるが――。

一方で、新人お披露目公演でのteam鳳の暴走に、嫌悪感を露わにする
華桜会メンバーがひとり――静かに動き始める。

Summaries.eng:
Team Otori is working hard to practice for the Ayanagi Festival performance.
One day, Otori was called by Hiiragi.

Hiiragi said, "The existence of team Otori violates the tradition and dignity of Ayanagi Gakuen."
Point out the choices in the phoenix.

Is it a genius to make use of, or the future of five people who have begun to shine like stardust?
When faced with a decision, the hidden past of Otori and Hiiragi becomes clear.
Summaries.jpn:
綾薙祭公演に向けて、稽古に励むteam鳳。
そんなある日、鳳が柊に呼び出された。

柊は、「team鳳の存在は、綾薙学園の伝統と品位を侵すもの」と告げ、
鳳にある選択を突きつける。

生かすべきはひとりの天才か、星屑のように輝き始めた5人の未来か……。
決断を迫られた時、鳳と柊の秘められた過去が明らかになる。

Summaries.eng:
Otori suddenly left the school.
Confusion, resentment, and suspicion swirl in Hoshitani's chest, which had not been told anything.

However, the test stage will not wait ...!
Team Otori tries to kill her anxiety and look in front of her,
She thinks so, and the more she desperately feels, the more her hearts fall apart ...

Meanwhile, Hoshitani invites Nayuki to "go out together once in a while!"
Summaries.jpn:
突然、学園を去った鳳。
何も聞かされていなかった星谷たちの胸には、戸惑いと、憤りと、疑念が渦巻く。

しかし、テストステージは待ってはくれない……！
不安を押し殺し、前を向こうとするteam鳳だが、
そう思って必死になるほど、心がバラバラになっていく気がして……。

そんななか、星谷は那雪に「たまには一緒に出掛けよう！」と誘う。

Summaries.eng:
Team Otori started to move forward with five people.
One day, Hiiragi tells us about extracurricular activities in the field of professional musicals.

What appeared at the site where Hoshitani and his colleagues went as help staff--,
It was a prince of the musical world that is thrilling now!

On the other hand-Hoshiya still has a stumbling block in his heart.
"Why did Otori-senpai leave us ..."
It turns out that the reason was to protect ourselves--!
Summaries.jpn:
5人で前を向いて進み始めたteam鳳。
そんなある日、柊から、プロのミュージカルの現場での課外活動が言い渡される。

星谷たちがお手伝いスタッフとして赴いた現場に現れたのは――、
なんと、今をときめくミュージカル界のプリンスだった！

一方で――心にいまだ引っかかりが残っている星谷。
「鳳先輩は、どうしてオレたちの元を去ったのか……」
その理由が、自分たちを守るためだったと判明して――！

Summaries.eng:
Hoshitani and his friends overcame their anxieties and celebrated the day of the Ayanagi Festival.

However, a typhoon approaches Ayanagi Gakuen relentlessly.
It is decided that the program on the outdoor stage, which is the venue for team Otori's performance, will be cancelled.

"I want a lot of customers to see our musical, which was taught by Otori-senpai."
What is the future of such Hoshitani's dreams? The final chapter of the stage of youth!

We don't know how to give up on our dreams!
Summaries.jpn:
不安を乗り越え、綾薙祭当日を迎えた星谷たち。

しかし、無情にも綾薙学園に台風が接近。
team鳳の公演会場である野外ステージでのプログラムは中止という決定が下る。

「鳳先輩に教わったオレたちのミュージカル、たくさんのお客さんに見てもらいたい」――
そんな星谷たちの夢のゆくえは？　青春のステージ、最終章！

オレたちは、夢を諦める方法なんて、知らない――！

Summaries.eng: Yūta Hoshitani, who enrolled in the prestigious Ayanagi Academy for music entertainment, passed the first-year test to become a musical department student in his second year. However, the new school year immediately presents new trials for the returning students. The first task on the second-year curriculum is supporting the graduation stage performance of Ōtori and the other graduating Kaō Council members. There are five roles known as "second-year training roles" in the legendary musical Shadow & Lights. Every year, a team of only five second-year students get to step on stage as performers in the musical. To earn a ticket to glory, Hoshitani and 24 other new musical department students take on the training auditions.

Hoshitani Yuta and the other members of Team Otori have successfully overcome the trials of their first year and made it into Ayanagi Academy's musical department. A new school year begins and there is much excitement in the air as the department prepares for its annual graduation celebration performance for its upcoming graduating third years, which includes Otori, Hiragi, and the other members of the Kao Council as the stars. The musical, "Shadow & Lights" even offers the second years a chance to shine but before Hoshitani and the others can stand on stage with their former coach they will need to overcome the other teams as well. Now, the curtain has risen on a new stage!
Summaries.jpn:
晴れてミュージカル学科生となった星谷たち。
学年も上がり、これまでライバルだった他チームのメンバーとはクラスメイトに。
さっそく親睦を深めようとする星谷だが、
team楪のリーダー・揚羽を始めとする新しい仲間たちは、一癖も二癖もある個性派揃いで……。
一方、ミュージカル学科２年生としての最初のカリキュラムが発表される。
それは、前・華桜会主演の卒業記念公演をサポートすること。
今、新たな幕が上がる！

Summaries.eng: The competition for the five second year training roles in the much-anticipated school musical "Shadow & Lights" is set to begin. This time, however, the boys are being mentored by former alumni who know the musical better than anyone. These experienced graduates are known as the Ancients and include former members of the Kao Council from Tsukigami Kaito's older brother's generation. Hoshitani and the others are ready to take on the challenge but one student, Ageha Riku of Team Yuzuriha, will stop at nothing to follow in the footsteps of his idol, Tsukigami Haruto. A new set of trials begin as each boy longs to stand in the spotlight alongside their admired mentors.
Summaries.jpn:
特別コーチ・アンシエントの指導が始まった。
星谷たちが挑むのは伝統の演目、
ミュージカル『Shadow＆Lights』の≪２年生育成枠≫５役をかけたオーディション。
元指導者との共演を果たすべく、チームそれぞれが作戦を立て始める。

一方、アンシエントたちはブロードウェイ遠征中の遥斗から
ある“ミッション”を言い渡されているらしく……？

Summaries.eng: While practices for the training roles are underway with guidance from the Ancients, Hoshitani spends his days receiving strict special guidance from Uozumi due to his lack of acting skills. To lighten things up a bit, Tatsumi and Sawatari suggest going to the middle school's drama club performance for a change of scenery. The joyous mood of the event is threatened when one of the performers in the play drops out due to illness. When Sawatari suddenly recommends Hoshitani as the replacement he worries about his lack of skills but with the encouragement of his friends he steps out on stage. Will the show be a success?
Summaries.jpn:
アンシエントによる役別稽古が行われている中、
演技力の至らない星谷は鬼コーチの魚住から厳しい特別指導を受ける日々。
辰己と申渡は、そんな星谷に
「気分転換に綾薙学園中等部の部活発表会に行かないか」と誘う。
賑やかなお祭りムードの中等部で、星谷が遭遇した人物は――？
そして、星谷を待ち受けていたアクシデントとは――！？

Summaries.eng: After being told by Ageha that they are not the same Hoshitani suddenly feels down wondering why they would be so different. The members of Team Hiragi point out that it's most likely because Hoshitani lacks a few things that many of the rest of them possess. Meanwhile, Tengenji invites his teammates and classmates to a performance of one of his family's Gothic Kabuki shows and come to realize he is not all talk when it comes to his professional status. The show reignites the fire in the young men to take on the training role auditions with renewed vigor.
Summaries.jpn:
揚羽からキッパリと「同じじゃない」と言われてしまった星谷は、
いつになく落ち込み気味。
「何が違うのかな」と悩む星谷に、team柊は、
役者として星谷には足りないものがあると指摘する。

一方、天花寺は本職である歌舞伎の舞台に出演中。
招待してもらった星谷たちは、
天花寺のプロの役者としての姿を目の当たりにして、格の違いを痛感する。

Summaries.eng:
Kaito has found himself in a slump going up against Ageha, who is copying his older brother
Haruto's performance. Noticing this, Uozumi pulls Kaito and Hoshitani aside and suggests that they switch the roles that they are going to be auditioning for. This obviously upsets Kaito, who took on the most difficult role for both his team and for himself, and he is unable to be swayed. This situation sends a wave of dissonance throughout all the teams as the boys struggle to find their motivations for the upcoming auditions. Will they be able to overcome their anxiety?
Summaries.jpn:
兄・遥斗の演技を完璧にコピーする揚羽に影響され、スランプ気味の月皇。
それを見透かしたかのように、魚住は月皇と星谷に対してある提案をする。
「お前たち、受ける役をコンバートしろ」
チームのために一番の難役を任されている月皇は納得ができず、
魚住に食ってかかってしまう。 不協和音は、その様子を目の当たりにしたカンパニーにも伝染して――。

Summaries.eng: Haruto suddenly arrives at practice, much to the surprise of everyone, and announces that he will be in Japan only for a short while. In order to make the most of his brief time with the students, Haruto announces that they will be going on a training retreat. However, upon their arrival at their camp location Teams Otori and Hiragi are less than thrilled to be back at the Hiragi Family Villa from last year. A specially planned orienteering activity begins the camp and with the promise of a special prize for those who do the best, the boys set off on their way. Of course, things don't quite go as planned when Hoshitani's team one suddenly winds up missing.
Summaries.jpn:
ブロードウェイ遠征中の遥斗が突然帰国し、カンパニーは騒然。
興奮冷めやらぬ星谷たちに、
アンシエントは３週間にわたる大型稽古合宿を決行すると告げる。
しかし、合宿初日のメニューは想像していたものとは少し違っていて――。

「頑張った人にはご褒美があるからお楽しみに」
果たして、星谷たちに用意されたご褒美とは――！？

Summaries.eng: Now that Hoshitani realizes that Otori is his long admired high school student, he doesn't know what to do or how to act and his suddenly odd behavior begins to worry those around him. Meanwhile, Ageha is thrilled with finally getting to meet his "god", Tsukigami Haruto, and is eager to prove that he is the most suited for Haruto's former role. However, Haruto doesn't react to Ageha's performance as he had hoped and Ageha is thrown into doubt. As the Ancients get closer to make a decision on the training roles a surprise announcement is made that turns the entire audition on its head.
Summaries.jpn:
ついに『憧れの高校生』の正体を知ってしまった星谷。
それは予想もしていなかった相手で、動揺のあまりすっかり挙動不審に。
一方、揚羽は憧れの『神様』と会えたことに興奮気味。
しかし揚羽のパフォーマンスを見た遥斗は、思いがけない言葉を口にする。

様々な想いが交錯する中、アンシエントは≪育成枠≫の選出に向けて、
ある決断を下そうとしていた。

Summaries.eng: The mood around the training camp has darkened considerably as everyone has noticed Ageha's absences at practice. After the shock of Haruto's scathing words Ageha has shut himself in his room and refuses to come out. No one feels Ageha's absence more than Hoshitani, who is concerned for a person he sees as a friend, but when he tries to speak with Ageha he is quickly turned away. Lamenting to his friends Hoshitani wonders if he can really do anything to help. The best advice comest from an unexpected source and Hoshitani is even determined to coax Ageha out of his room for sure.
Summaries.jpn:
遥斗に否定されたショックで、
部屋に籠り、稽古に出て来なくなってしまった揚羽。
心配する星谷は、同じ役を目指す仲間として励ましたいと思ってはいるものの、
何故だかいつもの調子で踏み出すことができずにいた。
「星谷くんにも、苦手な相手っているんだね」
那雪の言葉に、自分にとって揚羽が特別な存在なのだと気付き、星谷は――。

Summaries.eng: The announcement of the results of the training role auditions creeps ever closer as the boys change gears from team to individual auditions. Things are finally going well between Hoshitani and Ageha, but Hoshitani notices that Nayuki suddenly seems to be avoiding him. Naturally concerned Hoshitani tries to reach out to his friend but Nayuki only pushes him away more. With the auditions now an indiviual challenge Nayuki finds himself feeling inadequate compared to his diversely talented team mates and competitors. Just when it seems as though Nayuki is about to give up he finds that he is not alone in how he feels.
Summaries.jpn:
育成枠オーディションの結果が発表される瞬間が近付いている。
親友の星谷と、支え合い、励まし合いながら稽古に励んできた那雪だが、
オーディションがチーム戦から個人戦になったことで、
より個人のレベルが重視されることになり、ふと不安を覚え始める。
そんな時、同じようにナーバス気味になっている人物がいることに気付き……。

Summaries.eng: Suddenly being thrust into a main role has left Hoshitani reeling. While he is happy to finally be given the chance to perform on stage with his admired senpai, Otori, Hoshitani finds himself in an unusual slump when it comes to practicing the critical duet between Lambert and Alexis. No matter how many times they practice Hoshitani simply chokes in the middle of the song. His friends all assume it's just nerves but when Hoshitani mysteriously goes missing one day mild concern turns into panic as they each split up to find him. Will Hoshitani be able to shake off this slump and take on his new role as Lambert?

With only a few days left until the graduation celebration performance the final details begin to fall into place. Thanks to Hiragi's prior encouragement and the support of all the treasured items from his friends, Hoshitani has found the confidence to step into the role of Lambert and go after his dream. Spirits are high during dress rehearsal and the stage is set for an amazing performance. As the show gets underway everything proceeds smoothly until an accident behind the scenes potentially puts one of the performers and the fate of the show at risk.
Summaries.jpn:
卒業記念公演はもう目前。稽古も仕上げの段階に入っている。
仲間たちから受け取った“宝物”を抱き、今、大舞台に立とうとしている星谷を、
優しい眼差しで見つめる空閑。
実は空閑には、未だ明かしていなかった星谷への特別な想いがあった。

育成枠オーディションの間、それぞれの場所で頑張ってきたteam鳳。
５人の絆を確かめ合うように、集い、円陣を組む。
「オレたち、スターダスト！！！！！」

Summaries.eng: Hoshitani has fallen into the trap room and injured his shoulder; yet, even in pain, he still wishes to continue on with the show despite the next scene involving a trying dance. Uozumi attempts to talk Hoshitani out of it ordering that Inumine go on in his place, however, once Inumine goes on stage, Hoshitani cannot take back the role. As Inumine readies himself to finish the play in Hoshitani's place, Ageha comes forward with a plan that would allow Hoshitani to go back out on stage, despite his injury. The fate of Hoshitani's dream and the finale of the show hangs in the balance...
Summaries.jpn:
奈落落ちの事故で負傷した星谷。
応急処置は受けたものの、痛みのせいで一時的に腕が上がらなくなってしまう。
万全でない状態で役者が舞台に上がるべきではないと、
断腸の想思いで途中降板を促す魚住だが、
それは星谷にとってあまりに辛い決断であった。

一方、星谷の状況を知らされた鳳もまた決断を迫られる。
「お前が言えば、星谷も諦めがつくかもしれない……」

星谷の夢のゆくえは？　今再びの最終幕！

Summaries.eng: Following a successful graduation performance, Yuuta Hoshitani and the rest of the second years begin preparations for the upcoming Ayanagi Festival. This year's festival is the first time the students will be without their Kao Council mentors, giving them the creative freedom to do what they want. Hoping to perform alongside each other for once, the second years decide to put on a joint production together. The festival’s opening ceremony will also serve another purpose—to reveal next year's Kao Council candidates.

The start of the second term, Hoshitani and the others are prepping for their class production for the Ayanagi Festival. This will be their first production without their older mentors. Team Otori, Team Hiragi, Ageha, Hachiya, Kitahara, and Nanjo are all part of the same team this time and swear to do their best together. However, the current Kao Council is pushing for new reforms to the way things are usually done. The closing of the outdoor theater, former practice spaces that cannot be used anymore, and a school under transition... Does progress or chaos await? Now the curtain rises on the next chapter!
Summaries.jpn:
２学期が始まり、綾薙祭でのクラス公演に向けて動き出した星谷たち。
初めて指導者の助けを借りずに作り上げるステージ。
同じ班となったteam鳳、team柊、揚羽、蜂矢、北原、南條は、
手を取り合って頑張ろうと誓い合う。
しかし、彼らの前に『改革』を推し進める華桜会が立ちはだかろうとしていた。

閉鎖される野外劇場、使われなくなった旧校舎の稽古場、変化してゆく学園。
待ち受けるのは進化か、混乱か。今、次なる幕が上がる！

Summaries.eng: Team Hiragi has been removed from the class production on the orders of the Kao Council. The remaining members are at a loss, is the merry company already in the midst of a crisis?! Kitahara tells Hoshitani and the others to see the experience as a tough life lesson, while Tatsumi and Team Hiragi make it clear that they regret the circumstances, having wanted to perform with the others. Hoshitani finds himself conflicted, happy for his friends, but wanting to find some way to perform together. In the midst of his inner conflict, Hoshitani has an encounter with an unfamiliar and mysterious person.
Summaries.jpn:
華桜会の命により、クラス公演からteam柊が外れることに。
途方にくれる残されたメンバー。早くもカンパニーの危機！？
「芸の世界にはどうしようもない理不尽もある」と北原に諭されるも、
「一緒にステージに立ちたかった」というteam柊の無念さを想い、居ても立っても居られない星谷。
だけど、どうしたら……。

そんな時、星谷の前に謎の人物が現れる。一体何者……？

Summaries.eng: Instead of trying to get Team Hiragi back for their production, Hoshitani, Ageha, and Kitahara ask the Kao Council to join them in performing in Opening Ceremony. Sadly, however, their bold request is completely rejected. Hoshitani and the others refuse to give up and come up with a crazy gamble to try and break the deadlock. Meanwhile, Irinatsu has been tasked with composing the music for Opening Ceremony, but has been unable to find any inspiration and the song remains unfinished. Feeling the pressure from Fuyusawa, Irinatsu finds a distraction in Hoshitani and the others.
Summaries.jpn:
team柊を取り戻すのではなく、team柊と一緒にオープニングセレモニーの舞台に立つ！
そう目標を定めた星谷たちだが、華桜会にあえなく却下される。
まともに取り合ってももらえない状況を打開しようと、ある大勝負に出てみるが……。

一方、オープニングセレモニーで使用する楽曲の制作を手掛ける入夏は、
決め手となるインスピレーションが湧かず、
未だに曲のアレンジを完成させられずにいた。

Summaries.eng: The plan of Hoshitani and the others to go on strike backfires, and, as a precaution, the Kao Council separates Team Hiragi from their friends. At a loss of what to do, the remaining company members are left feeling dejected, so Hoshitani takes off to go see the isolated Team Hiragi and his friends hear nothing else from him for the rest of the day. Meanwhile, within the monolithic Kao Council, Kasugano can't shake the sense of unease that he feels. He finds his attention drawn to Shiki, who is working extra hard in his position as leader.
Summaries.jpn:
ストライキ作戦が裏目に出て華桜会に警戒されてしまった星谷たちは、team柊から完全に引き離されてしまう。
打つ手がなく沈み気味のカンパニーのために、単身team柊のもとへ突撃する星谷だが――なんと、そのまま音信不通に！？

一方、一枚岩に見える華桜会の中で春日野は一抹の不安を抱えていた。
組織のためにと力を尽くす四季の姿が、春日野の目には儚く映り……。

Summaries.eng: Still unable to get permission to perform in Opening Ceremony and now facing the prospect that they will be excluded from the Ayanagi Festival all together, Hoshitani and the others try to at least get their class performance time slot back. However, through their exchanges with Irinatsu and Kasugano, positive feelings for wanting to be acknowledged by the Kao Council have begun to emerge in the group. Though others, such as Nanjo, voice their doubts and a past relationship between him and Fuyusawa lead the others to wonder where Nanjo's loyalties really lie.
Summaries.jpn:
未だオープニングセレモニーへの出演を認めてもらえず、クラス公演の枠は返上してしまい、
このままでは完全に綾薙祭から締め出されてしまう事態に直面している星谷たち。
それでも、入夏や春日野との交流を経て、華桜会に認めてもらいたいという前向きな気持ちが芽生え始めていた。

そんな中、カンパニー内で思いがけないある疑惑が浮上。南條が……冬沢のスパイ！？

Summaries.eng: Using the information on the flash drive Nanjo procurred, Hoshitani and the others finally decide to take action to get approval from the Kao Council. However, in order for their plan to succeed, they need to communicate with Team Hiragi, and they're away at a training camp. Will they be able to reunite with Team Hiragi and execute their plan? An old friend conveniently appears right when things are looking precarious for this fateful stage.
Summaries.jpn:
南條が華桜館から持ち出したデータを使って、華桜会に認めてもらうべく、ついにアクションを起こすことを決める星谷たち。
しかし、作戦を伝えるべきteam柊は稽古合宿中で行方知れずに。
果たしてteam柊との再会を果たし、作戦を決行することは出来るのか……。

運命を左右するステージの幕が上がるその時――ついに、“あの人物”が姿を現す！？

Summaries.eng: After Shiki appeared and said he will listen to what they have to say, Hoshitani can't help feeling somewhat nervous. He worries that his rudeness towards Shiki, when he didn't know who he was, will count against them. However, when Hoshitani consults with an old friend, he receives some surprising advice. Meanwhile, Shiki holds true to his promise to consider expanding the number of performers for Opening Ceremony. A meeting between the five members of the Kao Council takes place to discuss the matter.
Summaries.jpn:
話を聞いてやると言われたものの、これまでの四季に対する無礼がマイナスに働かないかと
気が気でない星谷は、ほんの少しナーバス気味。
しかし相談を受けた“あの人”は、星谷に意外な言葉を贈るのであった。

一方、四季は約束通り、オープニングセレモニーの出演枠拡大について検討をしていた。
重々しい扉の向こうで、華桜会5人による話し合いが行われる。

Summaries.eng: With Shiki's persuasion, the Kao Council decides to expand the number of performers for Opening Ceremony. Once again back to a 14-person company, Hoshitani and the others devote themselves to practice. Meanwhile, a slight rift is beginning to form between Shiki, who agreed to the second-years' request, and Fuyusawa, who is determined to avoid any risk of failure. The difference between their goals, ideals, and feelings becomes increasingly clear.
Summaries.jpn:
四季の説得もあり、華桜会はオープニングセレモニーの出演枠拡大を決定する。
晴れて１４人カンパニーに戻れた星谷たちは、全員での稽古に精を出すのであった。

その一方で、２年生の意向を受け入れた四季と、断固リスク回避派の冬沢の間には小さな亀裂が……。
２人が目指す、それぞれの理想とは……交錯する想いとは……。

Summaries.eng: Hoshitani and the other second-years have started to make progress, but an unsettling mood in the Kao Council threatens to disrupt things. Shiki and Fuyusawa have agreed to fight each other for their ideals, and their quarrel is messing with the other Kao Council members as well. At the same time, Tatsumi finds himself overtaken by certain feelings. Sawatari quietly watches over Tatsumi as he works out his thoughts. Sawatari takes a certain sense of pride in supporting Tatsumi as a childhood friend and a best friend.
Summaries.jpn:
１４人揃って前進し始めた星谷たち２年生だったが、華桜会には不穏な空気が流れていた。
互いの理念をかけて戦うと決めた四季と冬沢。そんな２人に他華桜会メンバーをも翻弄されてゆく。

一方、辰己はある想いに駆られていた。
そんな彼を、静かに見守る申渡。幼馴染みとして、親友として、辰己を支える申渡の心には、ある矜持があって……。

Summaries.eng: Opening Ceremony has been split into two stages. Rumors are spreading around the school that the Kao Council is divided and that Hoshitani and the other second-years are the cause. Shiki and Fuyusawa clash over their differences once again, and Fuyusawa angrily decides to take action. He completely calls into question Shiki's suitability to lead. "I'm with Shiki," Chiaki says, giving Fuyusawa one final warning now that he can no longer turn back.

Team Otori is in low spirits due to Shiki's expulsion from the Kao Council. Knowing full well what it feels like to lose their coach, the boys do their best to reach out to Shiki and get through to him for the sake of his own team. Meanwhile, Fuyusawa can't help the empty feeling consuming him after his victory over Shiki. Tatsumi and the other members of Team Hiragi picks up on Fuyusawa's change and attempt to speak to him as well. Finally, the day of the Ayanagi Festival arrives...

As the starting time for Opening Ceremony draws nearer, the seats in the theater begin to fill, yet there is no sign of Shiki. Worried, Hoshitani begs the others to give him time to go look for Shiki, but the rest of Team Otori insists on joining him. At the same time, Kasugano notices that Fuyusawa is acting strangely. The second-year students are hoping for all five members of the Kao Council to see their performance, and, in the face of their strong beliefs, Fuyusawa is finally moved. The curtain is now rising on the new future of Ayanagi Academy and the dreams of Hoshitani and company!
